parameters.query:
WITH recent AS (
  SELECT j.id, j.source, j.source_url, j.title, j.company, j.location, j.work_mode, j.fetched_at,
         m.final_score, m.rules_score, m.ai_score, m.matched_skills, m.missing_skills,
         m.reasoning, m.red_flags, m.needs_review
  FROM jobs j
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT * FROM job_matches mm
    WHERE mm.job_id = j.id
    ORDER BY mm.created_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) m ON true
  WHERE j.source <> 'synthetic'
    AND COALESCE(j.posted_at, j.fetched_at) >= now() - interval '14 days'
),
best AS (
  SELECT * FROM recent
  WHERE final_score >= 50
  ORDER BY final_score DESC, fetched_at DESC
  LIMIT 15
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT skill, count(*) AS n
  FROM recent, unnest(missing_skills) AS skill
  WHERE final_score >= 40
  GROUP BY skill
  ORDER BY n DESC, skill
  LIMIT 8
)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'new_jobs',     (SELECT count(*) FROM jobs WHERE source <> 'synthetic' AND fetched_at >= now() - interval '24 hours'),
  'total_jobs',   (SELECT count(*) FROM jobs WHERE source <> 'synthetic'),
  'scored',       (SELECT count(*) FROM recent),
  'strong',       (SELECT count(*) FROM recent WHERE final_score >= 70),
  'moderate',     (SELECT count(*) FROM recent WHERE final_score >= 50 AND final_score < 70),
  'needs_review', (SELECT count(*) FROM recent WHERE needs_review),
  'top',          (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(row_to_json(b) ORDER BY b.final_score DESC, b.fetched_at DESC), '[]'::json) FROM best b),
  'gaps',         (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('skill', g.skill, 'count', g.n) ORDER BY g.n DESC, g.skill), '[]'::json) FROM gaps g)
) AS data;

INSERT INTO reports (report_date, title, markdown, data)
VALUES ($1::date, $2, $3, $4::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (report_date) DO UPDATE SET
  title = EXCLUDED.title,
  markdown = EXCLUDED.markdown,
  data = EXCLUDED.data,
  created_at = now()
RETURNING id, report_date;
